title: Figure 10: Artist's rendition of a four-engine positron SSRV in flight
description: Computer-style artist's rendering of a white delta-wing spaceplane with twin tail fins and four underslung engine pods flying against a blue sky with clouds. Caption: "Figure 10. Artist's Rendition of a Four-Engine Positron SSRV (courtesy of Positronics Research LLC)." Text below introduces positron-powered rockets.
